answer: A two-square-metre plot grows one identity: a vine cutting grafted in place, left 90 days. A raven feather sealing the graft is hashed by barb pattern; a moved cutting breaks the seal. Roots descend an echo tube a centimetre a day; any peer can tap its mouth and time the echo against the curve. One honest grower pays $25, refunded after an exit tap; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 plots, 90 days and $25,000, since a split crown roots in neither plot. A transplanted vine, its root column truncated and its echo early, loses the $25 and its registration when any peer repeats the tap and posts the timing.
